explanation: App.tsx is now the view switch (about 350 lines): it calls useExplorer once above it, hands explorer.nav and explorer.at to useAppRouter, composes the one user-move callback (supersede then navigate) and renders <ErrorBoundary key="explorer"><ExplorerShell/></ErrorBoundary>, so a throw in the explorer screen no longer blanks the page. The explorer-on-screen effect stays in App after the router so it still runs after a boot landing. App keeps the changelog and study-details flags, which outlive a visit to the explorer. appRouter.ts imports ExplorerNavigation and ExplorerAt as types from explorer/useExplorer.ts instead of declaring them; the entry bundle gains no runtime import.
